synthesis: Dominant pattern: NEVER_CANCELLED orphans, not cancel races. 7 of 9 leg-2 exchange fills were EXACTLY AT the pair bound (97-leg1); the >97 'violations' on those 7 are booking artifacts from reconcile adopting at mark-to-market avg (8290-8291). Only TSIAND (+4, stale-snapshot move_repost above bound) and GARCIO (+1, true cancel-fill race) overpaid on the exchange.
